Component casings

Every part rides in the same kind of block: 20 mm tall, split through the lead plane and glued, with the leads leaving the bottom on the 2.54 mm grid. The Hand-E grips the block, never the part. Jumpers reuse the original 5 mm jumper casing's channels, moved to each spacing.

Casing

Show

Selected (mm)

Halves and parts are the actual geometry from casings.py: the orange half is half 1 (y < 0), the teal one half 2. Print each half lying on its outer face, split face up, no supports. Parts are the kit's, at standard sizes: 1/4 W resistor, 5 mm LED, RGB LED, TO-92 S8050/S8550, 104 disc, 12 mm buzzers (active 9.5 mm, passive 8.5 mm tall). The buzzer casings are thicker so the block covers the buzzer. The sparks are for show only.
